vis-network 9.1.6, standalone UMD build, copied from the npm package `vis-network@9.1.6`
(`standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js`). Dual licensed: Apache-2.0 or MIT (both files are here).

It is the library that the `graph.html` viewer made by Graphify loads (from unpkg). It is vendored
here so the Impact map draws its graph the same way with no network access.
